title: Really bad toaster and cheaply made
text: Really bad toaster and cheaply made. If you live Yoda, you may want to own this just because but that’s not a good enough reason. Not worth adding to your collection. It looks cheap and feels cheaply made. It operates as though it was a cheaply made toy. At best, it will toast a piece of white bread. And it’s ugly. The product has no redeeming value even for a Yoda collector.
